Determines whether this widget is the currently active one by comparing it against the result of FieldGetter_79d0 applied to the object pointer at this+0x40. If this is not the active widget but its flag at this+0xE0 and cursor flag at this+0xE1 are both set, it deactivates with SetterVTableIDCheck(this, 0) and emits the same notification. Returns the widget flag byte when no state change occurs. Called by VirtualDispatchWrapper (0048BC70).
